subject: Founders Program: clarification on onboarding credits and eligibility

Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Founders Program credits — eligibility question

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this call last week. We're excited about the trial — SproutAI is part of Seed Studio's winter cohort and we were told Redwood offers founders/onboarding credits. A couple of quick questions before we kick off the pilot: 

- Are the founders credits usable on Dedicated (we're planning a short Dedicated pilot to validate latency)?
- Do credits expire after X days, or can they be applied to an invoice if we convert to a paid plan?
- Any limits on inference or embedding units we should be aware of?

I've attached a small usage sample from our PoC (sproutai-usage-report.csv). Procurement will also want a short note about the program for their onboarding checklist.

Appreciate a quick clarification — want to line up the pilot next week.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of ML, SproutAI
alice@sproutai.com

Attachments: sproutai-usage-report.csv (CSV, 24 KB)
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@sproutai.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders Program credits — eligibility question

Hi Alice — thanks for sending this over and welcome to the cohort. Short answers up front:

- Founders/onboarding credits are primarily scoped to our hosted API.
- We can make a short-term exception for Dedicated pilots in specific cases, but that requires approval and an addendum.
- Credits have a 90-day standard expiration from issuance; we can discuss a one-time extension for procurement needs.

Monica (AE) and Marissa (CS) are looped in to help with the eligibility check and to propose a workable mutual action plan. Monica — can you confirm the credit bucket and whether the usage sample above would be covered if SproutAI runs a short Dedicated pilot? Marissa — quick note on what support hours we can include for the DevOps handoff would be helpful.

I'll wait for their replies; happy to do a quick sync if needed.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:47:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders Program credits — eligibility question

Hi Alice — great to meet you (virtually). I reviewed the usage sample (thanks) and outlined options below so you can share with procurement: 

Option A — Hosted-only founders credits (standard)
- Up to $15k in hosted API credits, valid for 90 days.
- Applies to token usage (generation and embedding).
- No Dedicated support or Dedicated provisioning covered.

Option B — Pilot Exception for Dedicated (needs approvals)
- We can approve a limited Dedicated pilot credit covering host fees for up to 2 weeks (or 50% of the expected Dedicated cost), subject to Security/Infra signoff and a short addendum.
- Requires forecasted usage, pilot dates, and a procurement point-of-contact.

Other notes: 
- If SproutAI moves to a committed Dedicated contract within 90 days of the pilot, we can discuss a promotional conversion credit and a limited ramp discount (typical structure: one-time conversion credit + 25% off committed rate for first 3 months).
- We can provide a short procurement letter confirming the program — I've attached a draft procurement note (see attachments).

Next steps: please send an estimated usage profile for the pilot (qps, avg token lengths, expected peak concurrency) and the procurement contact. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min mutual action plan (MAP) to lock dates and approvals.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and product: 

- Procurement needs a written statement that the credits can be applied to invoices if we execute a Dedicated commitment within 90 days. Is that something you can confirm in writing?
- On Dedicated pilot: we'd prefer a 2-week Dedicated window (approx. Mar 8–21) to validate latency for our realtime inference. Will Redwood be able to provision that slot?
- Can the onboarding credits be used to cover Cloud egress/infra fees if we run a hybrid (Redwood-hosted + our infra) setup?

If you can send the procurement letter + the MAP, I can route to procurement and product. Our procurement lead is Jordan Li (jordan.li@sproutai.com).

Best,
Alice

Alice — quick update after speaking with CS and Sales Leadership. We want to support SproutAI's pilot and make procurement simpler. Proposal below (one-time promotional addendum):

- Hosted onboarding credits: $15,000 applied immediately, valid 120 days (extended from standard 90).
- Dedicated pilot allowance: up to $5,000 in Dedicated host credits for a two-week pilot (Mar 8–21) — subject to security checklist and a short addendum.
- Conversion incentive: if SproutAI signs a 6- or 12-month Dedicated commitment within 90 days of pilot completion, Redwood will apply a one-time conversion credit equal to 20% of the first committed month and offer 25% off committed unit rates for the first 3 months.
- Support: we will include 8 engineering support hours for onboarding at no additional charge for the pilot window. Additional hours billable per our standard SOW.

Attachments: founders-promo-addendum.pdf (PDF, 34 KB)

Next steps: 
1) If this looks acceptable, please confirm pilot window and provide Jordan Li (procurement) as the signer.
2) I'll route the addendum for signature (DocuSign) once procurement confirms.
3) Marissa will coordinate the kickoff and provisioning checklist after DocuSign is complete.

Rafael Mendes
Sr. Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai
